The Money Club kya hai?
The Money Club ek safe aur secure mobile platform hai jahan aap Peer-to-Peer Online Saving/Self-Help Groups join karte ho. Yahan aap apni savings lend karke interest kama sakte ho ya for 4X amount tak borrow kar sakte ho– ghar baithe, bina paperwork ke, poora process mobile se!

Aapko verified users laane ki zaroorat nahi hain.  India ke kone-kone se aapke jaise "verified" logon ke saath, aap ek Money Club join karte ho jo pehle se Money Club team dwara verified hote hain.

Money Club sirf ek saving aur borrowing platform hi nahi, balki ek achi earning opportunity bhi deta hain, jahan aap bank ke Fixed Deposit ya Recurring Deposit se zyada return kama sakte ho.

Money Club aapki madad kaise karta hai?
1. Ye app aapko offline committee/Beesi ke saare benefits deta hai, plus:

2. Poora club mobile phone par manage hota hai

3. Yahan kabhi bhi paisa ek jageh jama nahi hota – funds directly ek member se doosre member ko transfer hote hain (through escrow accounts)

4. Saare transactions bank se bank ke beech, online hote hain

5. Aapki savings FD ya Mutual Funds se zyada return de sakta hai

6. Emergency mein fund lena asaan hai. 6-8 ghanton me paise aapke bank account me hote hain, bid ke baad.

7. Aap apne club members ke saath interact karke ache doston se bhi jud sakte ho

Money Club ke Highlights:
1. Money Club join karne ke liye koi document ki zarurat nahi

2. Sirf ek baar verification fee lagti hai jab aap pilot club join karte ho

3. Aap India ke sirf verified users  ke saath judte ho jo 

4. Har club mein minimum 6 aur maximum 20 members hote hain

5. Minimum contribution ₹200 per day se shuru hota hai (pilot club ke liye)

6. Starting pooled amount approx. ₹1200

7. Minimum bid hoti hai: 1% of the pool amount

8. Transactions UPI, Paytm, Google Pay, IMPS, etc. ke through online hote hain

9. App mein koi paisa deposit nahi hota – members aapas mein direct transfer karte hain 

10. Clubs ki frequency hoti hai: daily, 3-days, weekly, fortnightly aur monthly

11. App har transaction ka track rakhta hai aur SMS, email, aur app notification se updates deta hai

12. Money Club groups fully transparent hote hai, sabko pata hota hai kaun time pe pay kar raha hai aur kaun delay kar raha hai

13. Yahan flat commission nahi hai – humari commission 6% se start hoti hai aur aap apni transaction history ke basis par ise 0.3% tak kam kar sakte ho

Shuru kaise karein?
Agar aap ye padh rahe ho to aapko Money Club ke benefits saaf dikh rahe honge.

Toh bas ye simple steps follow karo:

App download karo aur Ekyc karo

Intro video dekho (ya agar concept samajh aata hai toh skip bhi kar sakte ho)

Apne details ke saath apply karo aur form submit karo

24 hours ke andar verification call aayega

Aapko Pilot (Trial) Club mein invite kiya jaayega – jahan ₹200 per day se club chalu hota hai. Agar 6 members hain, toh club 6 din chalega

Pilot club complete hone ke baad sabhi members Level 1 Verification se guzarte hain

Jo members successfully verify ho jaate hain, wo Real Club mein shift ho jaate hain

Pehla Real Club maximum 10 verified members ka hota hai, jahan ₹600 har 3 din mein contribute karna hota hai

Jaise-jaise aapki transaction history strong hoti hai, aapko higher amount aur multiple clubs ka option milta hai

Happy Money Clubbing! 🎉
📍 PS: Abhi Money Club sirf India ke liye available hai
